propositions: transition library signature split the force-bypass concept across force:bool, reason:str, and force_close:str|None; claim uses the canonical force:str|None shape; both must unify to force:str|None where the string is the audit reason and None means not forcing
CLI transition accepts both --force[=<reason>] and --reason as the force-bypass audit note, while claim does not; both must accept only --force[=<reason>] and drop --reason-as-force-note coupling

internal naming spells the force-bypass reason as force_reason, force_close, force_close_reason, and force_plan_review across modules; must unify in-memory spellings to force_reason while retaining the persisted status_data[force_close_reason] key for durability
legacy code calling transition(force_close=<r>) or transition(force=True) must warn via deprecation alias and map to the new force string parameter
bare --force must normalize to the audit reason (no reason given) identically across both transition and claim CLI verbs
